containerDefinitions.name: ingest
command: if [ -z "$APP_MODE" ]; then echo "FATAL: APP_MODE is not set (valid modes: api, worker)"; exit 1; fi; case "$APP_MODE" in worker) echo "pulse ingest worker started, polling queue"; sleep 3600;; api) echo "FATAL: api mode is the HTTP frontend, not for this service"; exit 2;; *) echo "FATAL: unknown APP_MODE=$APP_MODE"; exit 2;; esac
